english.title: False unsworn evidence at an inquest by a person under the age of 14 years
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person under the age of 14 years, appeared as a witness at an inquest at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..) into **(..SPECIFY THE CIRCUMSTANCES REQUIRING THE INQUEST..) and gave unsworn evidence which was false in that **(..SPECIFY THE FALSE NATURE OF THE EVIDENCE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph8(1), (2) and (3) of Schedule 6 to the Coroners and Justice Act 2009.
